featureName.description: Feature folder name, plural, e.g. Patients, LabResults

boundedContext.description: Replaces the BoundedContext namespace segment. This project has no context folders, so pass the feature name (e.g. Patients) and fix the namespace afterwards (see .ai/ai-agent-guide.md)

returnType.description: The MediatR response type, e.g. int, Guid, Unit
